quick_skim.title: Block encoding of semiseparable matrices via their generators
quick_skim.abstract: We present an explicit quantum circuit that constructs a block encoding of a generator-representable semiseparable (one-pair) matrix directly from its two generators. For an $N\times N$ semiseparable matrix with $N=2^{n}$, the circuit uses $2n+2$ ancilla qubits and has $O({\rm polylog} N)$ depth, and it realizes a $(2\sqrt{N},\,2n+2,\,2 \sqrt{2}\ \varepsilon)$-block encoding, where $\varepsilon$ is controlled by the accuracy of the state-preparation routines that load the generators. The building blocks of the circuit are cyclic shifts, swaps, and Hadamard gates, each admitting an efficient implementation through the binary decomposition of the relevant indices.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: An explicit quantum circuit block-encodes generator-representable semiseparable matrices directly from two generators with polylogarithmic depth.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对结构化矩阵缺乏高效量子访问方式的问题，本文提出直接由两个生成元构建半可分矩阵块编码的显式量子线路。线路仅使用循环移位、交换与Hadamard门，采用2n+2个辅助比特，深度为O(polylog N)，并给出精度可控的块编码参数。该结果为依赖结构化矩阵访问的量子算法提供了高效且可实现的块编码构造。
